001: Good morning! I need to open a checking account here.
Good morning! Yes, you can. Did you bring your documents, ma'am?
I brought my ID and proof of residence.
Perfect. I'll also need your CPF.
Sure, here it is. How long does it take to be ready?
In general, it's ready within two business days.

What an annoying situation! Do you remember when that happened, ma'am?
It happened this morning when I tried to make a purchase.
Let me check here in the system. What's the account number?
It's the savings account that ends in four hundred and twelve.
I found it. I'm already unblocking it for you.

No problem. The transfer is to an account at which bank?
It's to my brother's bank, Banco do Brasil.
I see. Do you have his full details?
Yes, I do. The branch and the account are here on this paper.
Great. I'll make the transfer right away.

Sure. You can also check it on the app.
I know, but the app isn't opening on my phone.
I understand. Let me check here. What's your CPF?
It's the one registered in the system, my own.
Okay. Your current balance is two thousand three hundred reais.

You can pay here at the teller or on the app.
I'd rather pay here in person, just to be sure.
No problem. Do you have the barcode?
Yes, I do. It's on the company's app.
Perfect. I'll register the payment for you.

Let's check that. Do you have the statement in hand, ma'am?
Yes, I do. Look here at this maintenance fee.

But I didn't ask for that package, it was a mistake.
You're right. I'll reverse the charge now.
007: I want to increase the limit on my credit card.
Let me check your profile here in the system.
I use the card every month and I pay on time.
That helps a lot in the analysis. What's your income?
My monthly income is five thousand reais.
With that amount, I can increase the limit to eight thousand.
008: I forgot my password for the bank app.
No problem, you can reset it through the app itself.
I tried, but I don't receive the confirmation code.
Let me check if your phone number is up to date.
It is, it's the same one as always.
Then I'll send a new code to you right now.
009: I need financing to buy a car.
We have several credit options. Do you already have an amount in mind, ma'am?
I need about forty thousand reais.
And in how many installments would you like to pay?
I'll run a simulation of the terms and show you the options.
010: I want to cancel a subscription I signed up for with my card.
Which subscription are you referring to exactly, ma'am?
It's a streaming service I don't use anymore.
I see. Have you tried canceling through the company's website?
I tried, but the website doesn't complete the cancellation.
I'll file a dispute for you here.
